tool_args.rationale: The high-gradient probe reveals a marked decline beyond the pilot range, consistent with the diagnosed gradient-triggered avalanche. Fit the siphon base and the threshold and strength of its piecewise loss jointly, then test on fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Original smooth siphon plus square-root branch
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Fresh confirmation decisively refuted it, and the high-gradient observations show a sharp decline.
The new high-gradient observations directly identify the proposed threshold extension; there is no evidence requiring a temporal ODE.
It does not identify the observed gradient threshold.
